Get a free starter when you join Nando’s Rewards.
When you join Nando's Rewards, you’ll automatically get a free starter to use on your next order.* You’ll have 30 days from sign up to use it - but who’s waiting that long?

How do I sign up to Nando's Rewards?
You can sign up to Nando's Rewards on our website or app and you'll get a free starter just for joining.
What menu items can you get with the free starter?
With a free starter you can get any free starter, from halloumi sticks with chilli jam to a cheesy garlic pitta. Dare to share is excluded.
Is there a minimum spend to redeem the free starter?
Yes, you'll need to spend at least £7 after the free discount has been applied in order to redeem your free starter.
How long do I have to use the free starter?
You’ve got 30 days after joining Nando’s Rewards to redeem your free starter.
Your free starter will expire 30 days after you sign up. After that, Rewards expire after one year, use them or lose them. Make sure to opt into our marketing comms to get reminders.
Yes, going digital is the best way to get the most out of Nando's Rewards. Download the app and make sure to add to your mobile wallet.
